en: Black‑and‑white coastal view showing a wide sandy beach curving along a bay, with scattered seaweed on the shore and two small figures walking near the waterline. A line of simple wooden fences or posts runs roughly parallel to the surf. Behind the beach is a small settlement of wooden houses and buildings, some on low bluffs, backed by treeless rolling hills. The setting appears rural and early-20th‑century. Along the bottom edge, in reverse, is a handwritten or scratched number and word that looks like an archival caption.
